data.body:
Completion evidence for the `[non-codebase]` CI criterion.

The fix landed as Gerrit change 3003, merged to `main` as commit `740983fe830`
("Expose Bedrock metered rate provenance").

Gerrit recorded `Verified +1` from the CI bot on revision
`13066886c7555e7890a9e5cc4e790994287d77bc`, which is the revision that was
submitted. That label is cast only by CI and only when the gating
`ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell passes, and that cell selects
`not integration and not external` — a superset of every other matrix cell.
So lint, typecheck and the full gating pytest selection all passed on exactly
the code that merged.

Change detail at the time of submit:

```
status=NEW rev=13066886c7555e7890a9e5cc4e790994287d77bc
LLM=+1 Verified=+1 unresolved=0
```

Submit returned `status=MERGED`, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 740983fe830
origin/main` exits 0, confirming the revision is on `main`.

The local `make verify` equivalent is not runnable on this macOS arm64 host.
`pypandoc-binary==1.17`'s `macosx_11_0_arm64` wheel ships an x86_64 `pandoc`
binary, so 17 pandoc-dependent tests fail with `Bad CPU type in executable`.
That is a host packaging defect unrelated to this change, and CI runs on Linux
where it does not occur.

The two targeted suites were also run directly against the merged revision:

```
pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k estimated
  -> 5 passed, 61 deselected in 1.04s
pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py
  -> 66 passed in 2.27s
```
